english.title: Driver of a vehicle in a Mersey Tunnel fail to make the appropriate toll payment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..), and about to drive the vehicle from]_
(B)_[the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..), and about to drive the vehicle from]_
(C)_[a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel, and about to ride the cycle from]_
(D)_[a cyclist on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel, and about to ride the cycle from]_

(E)_[the Metropolitan Borough of Wirral to the City of Liverpool]_
(F)_[the City of Liverpool to the Metropolitan Borough of Wirral]_

by means of the tunnels, you failed to cause the

(G)_[vehicle to proceed]_
(H)_[cycle to proceed]_

(I)_[to an appropriate toll payment point.]_
(J)_[beyond the toll payment point without having paid the appropriate toll as prescribed by the Schedule of Tolls in force at the time.]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(c) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and place
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas OR
being a cyclist in the Queensway Tunnel / on the approaches to the Queensway Tunnel
and about to drive the vehicle from
the Metropolitan Borough of Wirral to the City of Liverpool OR
the City of Liverpool to the Metropolitan Borough of Wirral
by means of the tunnels
failed to cause the vehicle to proceed to an appropriate toll payment point OR
caused the vehicle to proceed beyond the toll payment point
without having paid the appropriate toll as prescribed by the Schedule of Tolls in force at the time
